title: Deep parser path for Encapsulated Interface Transport
purpose: Reach nested EIT parsing via MEI type 0x0E Read Device Identification with a basic object request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse function 0x2B, MEI type 0x0E, read-device-id code 0x01, and object id 0x00, then return identification data or an exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0005 for unit_id plus 4-byte PDU
MEI type is 0e for Read Device Identification
request carries read-device-id code and object id fields
all multibyte fields are big-endian where applicable
issue_safety_notes: Targets deeper nesting, not any historical crash bytes.
